name: Gait sequence

phase_0.boundary_condition: The musculoskeletal envelope and the gravitational field.

VINIT.justification: The static equilibrium before the initiation of the first step.

TANCH.justification: The return to the initial stance configuration after a full stride.

AFWD.justification: The forward translation of the limb toward the next contact point.

AREV.justification: The downward force and deceleration as the limb meets the ground.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of individual steps into a continuous walk.

IMSCRIB.justification: The system's self-recognition of its own limb position in space.

FSPLIT.justification: The division of weight-bearing into lead and trailing limb paths.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of total body weight onto the new support base.

EVALT.justification: Successful friction and balance on the substrate.

EVALF.justification: Failure of the support phase leading to postural collapse.

ENGAGR.justification: The brief moment where both feet are simultaneously in contact with the ground.

IFIX.justification: The permanent physical displacement of the substrate left by the step.

phase_3.void_description: Pre-ambulatory state where no vector of motion is defined.
phase_3.true_description: Dynamic stability maintained during forward progression.
phase_3.both_description: Double-limb support where weight is neither fully transitioned nor static.

steps.domain_action: The body occupies a neutral standing position.
The nervous system maps current joint angles and muscle tension.
The motor cortex initiates weight shift, bifurcating support between limbs.
The lead limb enters swing phase, moving forward through space.
The lead foot achieves secure contact with the ground.
The system enters double support, holding both limbs in contact simultaneously.
The trailing limb undergoes deceleration and prepares for lift.
The system checks for slippage or obstacles on the trailing side.
Weight is reintegrated onto the new lead limb, completing the transition.
The current stride is linked to the next intended movement vector.
The pressure of the step leaves a permanent indentation in the soil.
The gait cycle closes as the body returns to a stable support phase.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: Central Pattern Generators in the spinal cord.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Afferent and efferent neural signaling pathways.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Vestibular system and cerebellum state tracking.

phase_6.cycle_cost: Metabolic ATP hydrolysis per muscle contraction.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Potential energy stored in postural alignment.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Kinetic energy dissipated into the environment and heat.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The cycle is a conservative oscillation where momentum is recovered through pendular mechanics.
